DtaPairRow.description:
One drug--target pair: a SMILES ligand, a protein sequence, and
an optional affinity value (the column the backend validates as
finite numeric at source rows when any row carries it).
DtaPairRow.title: DtaPairRow

GnnGraphSpec.description: One graph: node features + the 2×E source→destination endpoints.
GnnGraphSpec.title: GnnGraphSpec

PreferenceValue.description: One preference write — any strict-JSON-safe value.
PreferenceValue.title: PreferenceValue

RepurposingScreenRequest.description:
One seeded synthetic screen + fit + ranking request.

The geometry bounds mirror the backend's own rules exactly
(``>= 4`` cells, ``>= 3`` drugs, ``>= 2`` features, ``observed``
in ``[0.3, 1.0]``); the remaining caps are this route's sync-light
budget, stated in the registry.
RepurposingScreenRequest.title: RepurposingScreenRequest

base_estimator.description: registry classification model backing self-training (must expose predict_proba; default LogisticRegression)
base_estimator.title: Base Estimator

mask_fraction.title: Mask Fraction

get.description:
One column's values — the §11.1 chemistry-stage bridge.

Bounded by the chemistry request models' own ``max_length`` cap and
explicit about it: ``n_rows`` + ``truncated`` state the dataset's
real size so a bounded view never masquerades as the whole column
(§17.3's "a display limit must never silently truncate" rule).
Values ride ``json_safe`` (NaN/Inf → ``null``).
